issue.title: Prepared completion rejects Rust bob-cli checks for missing Python verification stages

task_type_fields.impact: Passing Rust work repeatedly launches recovery agents instead of completing. Add an appropriate project check catalog or Rust-native stage mapping while preserving real formatting/lint/test obligations. Large because the correct shared-tool versus project configuration boundary needs planning. The landing audit confirmed the recipe/catalog mismatch but did not itself rerun prepared host completion.
task_type_fields.location: bob-cli justfile check recipe and SASE prepared host-completion verification-stage mapping
task_type_fields.repro: Proposer bob-cli-8y.2 note #3 reports prepared completion recovering with missing_required_stage:formatting and 14 similar project failures. Current 99b2ac4 confirms just check runs cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features, and cargo test --no-fail-fast, emits no CHECK_STAGES, and sase tool list reports no named tools. Reproduce a prepared just check completion on this Rust project and inspect the required stages before changing policy; do not equate absent ruff/mypy stages with failed Rust work.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-8y.2 note #3 reports repeated missing_required_stage:formatting recoveries despite passing just check. This is verification infrastructure outside the Mermaid epic.

payload.entry: Obsolescence sweep (bob-cli-an.6 lander): the symptom changed. sase 321d881250 (sase-1n8.2) now refuses sase final prepare unless the check command matches a named check tool with stages: run_silent, so the recovery-agent loop should no longer occur. bob-cli still declares no such tool (sase tool list shows none), so prepared completion remains unusable here. Remaining scope: declare a run_silent check tool for bob-cli.

payload.description: Need the scope for the batch-14 check-tool phase
